abstract: KRAS is the most frequently mutated proto-oncogene in human cancers 1-3 . Progression to advanced disease is frequently associated with allelic imbalance of the KRAS locus with gain of the mutant allele and loss of the wild-type allele through clonal and sub-clonal loss of heterozygosity (LOH) 2 . While a large body of literature has focused on the effects of allelic imbalance on oncogene addiction through gain of the mutant allele, the role of the wild-type KRAS proto-oncogene in malignant progression has not been fully elucidated. To capture this phenomenon, we developed a first-in-class somatic mosaic and lineage tracing genetically engineered mouse model (smGMLT) of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma allowing for real time in vivo tracing of Kras -LOH. Longitudinal characterization of the smGMLT demonstrated the presence of a strong evolutionary bottleneck towards the selective loss of the wild-type allele at metastatic sites. Cross species analysis leveraging research autopsies and surgical specimens revealed that KRAS -LOH is associated with metastatic dissemination and shorter overall survival. Transcriptomic analysis through single-cell RNA sequencing uncovered a conserved phenomenon whereby KRAS -LOH is paralleled by an immune evasive phenotype through loss of the tumor-cell interferon response and reduced CD8+ T cell infiltration. In line with this evidence, orthotopic transplants of isogenic tumor populations differing for the Kras allelic status demonstrated that only cancer cells with Kras -LOH are are able to form tumors in immune competent animals. Restoration of the wild-type allele abrogates tumorigenesis in Kras -LOH transplants in immunocompetent through activation of the TBK1-IRF axis. Altogether, these studies demonstrate that the KRAS proto-oncogene is a functional tumor suppressor in pancreatic cancer exerting its function through interferon-mediated, cell-extrinsic modulation of the tumor immune microenvironment.
key_points_ko: KRAS 야생형 대립유전자의 소실(KRAS-LOH)은 췌장암의 전이 촉진 및 짧은 전체 생존기간(OS)과 연관이 있습니다.
야생형 KRAS가 소실되면 종양 세포의 인터페론 반응이 약화되고 CD8+ T 세포 침윤이 줄어들어 면역 회피 특성을 갖게 됩니다.
야생형 KRAS 유전자를 다시 복구하면 TBK1-IRF 축 활성화를 통해 종양 형성이 억제됩니다.
summary_ko: 본 연구는 전이성 췌장관선암종에서 정상 야생형 KRAS(KRAS wild-type) 유전자 소실(LOH)이 암 진행에 미치는 영향을 분석했습니다. 마우스 모델과 환자 조직 분석 결과, 야생형 KRAS 대립유전자의 소실은 췌장암의 전이 형성 및 짧은 전체 생존기간(OS)과 연관되어 있었습니다. 야생형 KRAS 소실이 일어난 암세포는 인터페론 반응이 감소하고 CD8+ T 세포 침윤이 줄어들어 면역을 회피하지만, 야생형 유전자를 복구하면 종양 형성이 억제되는 것을 확인했습니다.
title: The tumor suppressor role of the KRAS proto-oncogene in metastatic pancreatic cancer
title_ko: 전이성 췌장암에서 야생형 KRAS 원암유전자의 종양 억제 역할
